description: Genasis Trial Web App — interactive agentic-team demo (kanban + chat) plus a signup form for hosted Plane + Mattermost trial environments. Launched by `genasis init --trial`, deployed at trial.realstory.blog.

userStories.title: Bootstrap Next.js 15 trial app skeleton
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a working Next.js 15 (App Router) project with Tailwind CSS so subsequent UI stories have a foundation.
acceptanceCriteria: New Next.js 15 App Router project created at apps/trial-app/
Tailwind CSS v3+ configured with globals.css and tailwind.config.ts
TypeScript strict mode enabled in tsconfig.json
Root layout (app/layout.tsx) renders with default font and metadata title 'Genasis Trial'
`npm run dev` serves localhost:3000 with a placeholder home page
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Bootstrapped Next.js 15.5.15 (App Router) at /work/genasis/trial-app/. Tailwind v3.4.17, TS strict, Korean lang root. Dev server verified rendering 'Genasis Trial' on localhost:3000. PRD-stated path 'apps/trial-app/' realized as project root /work/genasis/trial-app/.

userStories.title: Add SQLite persistence layer for trial submissions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a SQLite store so trial submissions and credential updates persist across requests.
acceptanceCriteria: better-sqlite3 dependency added and initialized at db/index.ts

submissions table created via migration: id, token (unique), name, email, phone, project_name, team_size, tech_stack (json), message, status (pending|provisioned|revoked, default pending), credentials_json (nullable), created_at, updated_at
Token generator utility (crypto.randomBytes 24-byte url-safe) at lib/token.ts
DB file path configurable via DATABASE_PATH env var, defaults to ./data/trial.db
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: better-sqlite3@12.9.0 + @types/better-sqlite3@7.6.13 installed. db/index.ts exposes singleton getDb()/closeDb() with WAL journaling and CHECK-constrained status enum. lib/token.ts exports generateToken() returning 32-char base64url (24 random bytes). DATABASE_PATH env var honored, defaults to ./data/trial.db with mkdirSync recursive. Smoke-tested end-to-end (insert + select). /data is gitignored; runtime mkdirSync creates it on first connect.

userStories.title: Build app bar with 체험하기 / 신청하기 tab navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want a top app bar with two tabs so I can switch between the demo and the signup form on the landing page.
acceptanceCriteria: App bar component at app/components/AppBar.tsx with brand 'Genasis Trial' on the left
Two tab buttons '체험하기' and '신청하기' on the right; active tab visually highlighted
Tab state controlled via URL query param ?tab=demo|signup, default demo
Landing page app/page.tsx renders the active tab section based on the query param
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: AppBar at app/components/AppBar.tsx renders brand 'Genasis Trial' (left) and tab links '체험하기' / '신청하기' (right) using next/link with ?tab=demo|signup query. Active tab styled via aria-current='page' + dark background. Landing page app/page.tsx is async server component reading searchParams (Next 15 Promise) and renders DemoSection or SignupSection accordingly. Defaults to demo when tab is missing/unknown. Verified via curl on /?(default) and /?tab=signup — both 200, correct aria-current on the active tab. typecheck passes.

Three columns rendered with Tailwind: Todo (gray), In Progress (blue), Done (green)
Each card shows '#<id> <title>' and is rendered with rounded border + shadow
Layout fixed-height, columns scroll independently when overflow

userStories.description: As a user, I want a chat thread panel so the demo can show agent messages.

userStories.title: Implement scripted demo sprint state machine
userStories.description: As a user, I want the demo to play an 8-step sprint with animated kanban moves and chat messages so I can see agentic team collaboration in action.
acceptanceCriteria: Demo script at lib/demo-script.ts encodes the 8 steps from PRD §4.1 (PM → Frontend → Code-reviewer → QA)
useDemoSprint hook drives state transitions on the configured timing (2s/3s/6s/7s/9s/10s/12s offsets)
Kanban card movement animates via Framer Motion or CSS transition (300ms)
Chat messages append with a 600ms typing indicator before each
[▶ Run Demo Sprint] button starts/restarts the sprint; [Reset] returns to initial state

userStories.title: Build trial signup form UI
userStories.description: As a prospective trial user, I want to fill out a request form so I can apply for a hosted Plane + Mattermost trial.
acceptanceCriteria: SignupForm component at app/components/SignupForm.tsx with fields: name (required), email (required, format-validated), phone (optional), project_name (required), team_size (required select: solo/small/medium), tech_stack (optional multi-select: React, Next.js, Vue, Node, Python, Rust, Go, Mobile), message (optional textarea)
Required-field validation with inline error messages in Korean
Submit button disabled until required fields valid
Info banner '관리자 협의 후 기간 제한 없이 이용 가능합니다.' rendered below form
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add /api/submit route with Mattermost notification
userStories.description: As a prospective trial user, when I submit the form I expect my request to be saved and the maintainer notified in Mattermost.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/submit at app/api/submit/route.ts validates payload with zod
Inserts a submissions row with a freshly generated token and status='pending'
Posts to Mattermost via REST API using MM_BOT_TOKEN + MM_TRIAL_CHANNEL_ID env vars in the format from PRD §4.3
Returns 200 { token, statusUrl: `/status/${token}` } on success; 400 on validation error; 500 on MM failure (but submission row is still saved)
Form redirects to /status/<token> on success
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build /status/[token] page (pending state)
userStories.description: As a trial applicant, I want to revisit a status page using my token so I can check whether my request has been provisioned.
acceptanceCriteria: Route app/status/[token]/page.tsx loads the submission by token (server component)
If token not found: render 404 page with Korean copy
If status='pending': show 'Pending — 관리자 검토 중입니다' card with submitted summary
Page is server-rendered (no client fetch for initial state)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add /api/webhook for admin credential delivery
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to POST credentials back to the trial app so the applicant can see them on their status page.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/webhook at app/api/webhook/route.ts authenticated via WEBHOOK_SHARED_SECRET header
Accepts payload: { token, plane: { url, login, password, api_key, workspace_slug }, mattermost: { url, login, password, bot_tokens: { role: token, ... } } }
Updates submissions row: credentials_json populated, status='provisioned', updated_at refreshed
Returns 200 on success; 401 on bad secret; 404 on unknown token; 400 on schema mismatch
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Render credentials block on status page when provisioned
userStories.description: As a trial applicant, when my request is provisioned I want to see all credentials and a copy-ready genasis.toml block.
acceptanceCriteria: When status='provisioned', /status/[token] renders Plane URL/login, Plane API key + workspace slug, Mattermost URL/login, and a bot token list
Sensitive fields (password, api_key, tokens) masked by default with a 'Show' toggle
Genasis.toml snippet block generated from credentials with a 'Copy' button (uses navigator.clipboard)
Snippet includes [plane], [mattermost], and [agents] sections wired to provisioned values
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add Dockerfile and deployment config for trial.realstory.blog
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a reproducible container build so the trial app deploys to trial.realstory.blog.
acceptanceCriteria: Multi-stage Dockerfile at apps/trial-app/Dockerfile (deps → build → runner) producing a Node 20-alpine runtime image
next.config.js sets output:'standalone' for minimal runtime image
.dockerignore excludes node_modules, .next, .git, data/
docker-compose.yml at apps/trial-app/ mounts ./data for SQLite persistence and exposes port 3000
README.md documents required env vars: MM_BOT_TOKEN, MM_TRIAL_CHANNEL_ID, WEBHOOK_SHARED_SECRET, DATABASE_PATH
`docker build` succeeds locally

userStories.title: Add `--trial` flag to `genasis init` CLI
userStories.description: As a developer running `genasis init --trial`, I want the CLI to bootstrap a blank project and offer to launch the trial demo app.
acceptanceCriteria: Clap arg `--trial` added to the `init` subcommand in src/commands/init.rs
When --trial is passed: after standard init, prompt 'Launch trial demo app? (Y/n)' (uses dialoguer Confirm with default true)
On confirm: spawn the trial app as a background process (look up bin via TRIAL_APP_BIN env, fall back to `npm --prefix apps/trial-app run start`) and `open` http://localhost:3000
Prints 'Trial app running on http://localhost:3000 — Ctrl+C to stop' and a hint that the PID is recorded in .genasis/trial.pid
When --trial NOT passed, behavior is unchanged
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add `genasis example` subcommand for sample artifacts
userStories.description: As a tutorial user, I want `genasis example prd|design|prd2` to drop ready-to-use sample documents into my project so I can practice agent workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: New `example` subcommand in src/commands/example.rs accepting one of: prd, design, prd2
Templates stored at templates/examples/{prd.md.tera, design-system.md.tera, prd2.md.tera}; rendered into project root as PRD.md, design-system.md, PRD2.md
Refuses to overwrite an existing file unless `--force` is passed (returns error with helpful message)
`genasis example --help` lists the three subcommands
Tests pass
